content: The two bikers are moving towards each other at a combined speed of $18+12=30$ miles per hour. To cover $45$ miles, this will take $\frac{45}{30} = 1.5$ hours. In that amount of time, Alicia will have biked $1.5\times 18 = \boxed{\textbf{(D) }27}$ miles.
